title: Parameter trajectory engineering for state transfer and quantum sensing in non-Hermitian two-level systems
summary: Exceptional points (EPs) in non-Hermitian systems give rise to enhanced sensitivity and chiral state transfer, which are important for quantum technologies. Although parameter trajectories encircling EPs can control symmetric and chiral state transfer, their robustness against practical perturbations and their role in quantum sensing remain largely unexplored. Here, we study three time-modulated parameter loops in a non-Hermitian two-level system to show how trajectory design governs state-transfer symmetry, robustness, and sensing performance.
